description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the ChartService class within the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin. It contains setup routines, mock service initialization, and test cases verifying methods of ChartService related to retrieving chart data and employee distribution information.

classes.name: ChartServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ChartService in the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, instantiates ChartService, loads fixture data, and sets up mock services.

methods.name: testGetChartDao
methods.description: Tests that getChartDao() returns an instance of ChartDao.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDistributionBySubunit
methods.description: Tests the retrieval and properties of employee distribution data by subunit.
